Summary: Program crashes when Ray Tracing is turned on in settings
Description: When a user goes to Settings > Graphics > Ray Tracing > On, the program crashes. This is 100% reproducible. Expected behaviour is user should be able to turn the Ray Tracing Setting On/Off without issues

Summary: Text error when a user is asked to input their email ID - spelled as enail
Description: User goes to home page > Enters their email and password to login > The 'Email' field is spelled as 'Enail'. Expected behaviour is User should see 'Email'

Summary: Program crashed in OOM when running overnight Smoketest
Description: An overnight smoketest was run for testing Sparse Memory Alloc -> roughly 5.5 hours into the Smoketest the program crashes. This proves user's program will eventually run out of memory. Expected behaviour is user should be in program for however long without a crash

Summary: User faces flickering screen while scrolling on the website's Contact Us page
Description: Sometimes when a user in Light Mode theme browsers while scrolling down the Contact Us page, there is visible flickering.

Summary: After driving from Point A to Point B, user faces low FPS
Description: Users have reported while driving from Point A to Point B in our game, after a few minutes the FPS drops to 20-25, and only a reboot fixes this

Summary: Website is unable to send OTP to user for a password reset
Description: When a user tries to reset their password and receive an OTP, we're unable to send the OTP on the first attempt. After the 3rd or 4th attempt the user receives the OTP

Summary: Build incompatible with latest Sony SDKs for Windows x64, needs installation twice
Description: Latest SDK received from Sony is incompatible with our program builds, a reboot and a reinstall is required to bypass this issue

Summary: Text gets cut off while displaying subtitles
Description: When playing the mission 'Carribean Sea' -> Dialogue subtitles from Mitch gets cut off after the first line. User should be able to see the subtitles properly
